the_change: On the volley road (R.pk.length > 1, total not rewritten upstream) the Endure clamp and the survivesFromFull clamp no longer rewrite the row total above the packet loop; they run inside the loop against each arrival and tg.curHP at that moment, in the authority's priority order (Endure, then the from-full family). The deficit is folded into the existing _pkAdj correction, so dealt / _dealtEach / recoil read the clamped total through _reDealt exactly as before. MEDI_HITCOUNT_DROP_ON_COLLAPSE=1 restores the collapse road verbatim.
